pageHeader.title: Your Safety Matters
pageHeader.subtitle: Building trust so you can focus on connection

features.title: How We Keep You Safe
features.subtitle: Multiple layers of protection so you can focus on making real connections

phoneVerified.title: Verified Sign-In
phoneVerified.description: Every member verifies their email with a one-time code before joining. Real people only.

publicVenuesOnly.title: Public Venues Only
publicVenuesOnly.description: All meetups happen at cafés, gyms, and public spaces—never private locations.

quickReporting.title: Quick Reporting
quickReporting.description: Flag concerning behavior in two taps. Reports reach us straight away.

threeStrikeSystem.title: Three-Strike System
threeStrikeSystem.description: 3 reports = warning. 6 = suspension. 9 = six-month ban. No exceptions.

privateMessaging.title: Private by Default
privateMessaging.description: Chat stays in-app and your phone number is never shared. Your photo is only shown to people you share a plan, a chat or your Circle with.

photoVerification.title: Photo Verification
photoVerification.description: AI-powered selfie matching to prevent catfishing.

womenOnly.title: Women-Only Activities
womenOnly.description: A starter can make an activity women-only. Only members whose profile gender is Woman can join, and the exact place and time stay hidden until you're in.

guidelines.title: Community Guidelines
guidelines.subtitle: The standards that keep our community great

beRespectful.title: Be Respectful
points: Treat everyone with kindness and respect
No harassment, bullying, or hate speech

beHonest.title: Be Honest
points: Don't mislead others about who you are

womenOnly.title: Women-only activities
womenOnly.body: Women-only activities are open only to members whose profile gender is Woman. Whoever started the plan can remove someone who isn't a woman, anyone in it can report them, and Konectr reviews every removal. Misrepresenting your gender to access a women-only space is a Community Guidelines violation and results in immediate suspension. You can change your profile gender once; after that, changes require contacting support.

tips.title: Safety Tips
tips.subtitle: Best practices for safe and enjoyable meetups

beforeMeeting.title: Before Meeting
items: Review the profiles of people you'll meet

duringMeetup.title: During the Meetup
items: Meet at the venue, not before
Trust your instincts – leave if uncomfortable

afterMeetup.title: After the Meetup
items: Share feedback to help the community
Block users you don't want to see again

support.title: Need Help?
support.subtitle: If you ever feel unsafe or need to report something, we're here for you.
support.emergencyNote: In case of emergency, always contact local authorities first.
